_meta.session: Session 71 — Mythos 5 cyber benchmarks deep re-mine (PDF section 3.x)
_meta.notes: Deep mine of PDF section 3.x cyber capability evaluations (S65 missed entirely). 🌍 6 NEW SOTAs on existing cyber benchmarks (firefox_147_full_exploit 88.4 vs Preview 70.8 → +17.6pp / firefox_147_exploits 221 vs 181 / cybergym_targeted_repro 83.8 vs 83.1 / oss_fuzz_progress_rate 80 vs 76.7 / oss_fuzz_tier5 13 vs 10 / exploitbench_mean_score 10.44 vs 9.9). 🌍 6 NEW cyber benchmarks (exploitbench_mean_flags_autonudge / cybergym_any_crash / oss_fuzz_write_primitive / uk_aisi_doing_life_max_step / uk_aisi_last_ones_success_rate / fable_5_cyber_classifier_block_rate). KEY THREAT FINDINGS: Mythos 5 Firefox exploit gen 10x Opus 4.8 (88.4% vs 8.8%). CyberGym 99.4% any crash (effectively saturated). UK AISI: Mythos 5 'more proficient than any publicly available model' at small enterprise network attack. Fable 5 cyber classifier 407/410 episodes flagged (99.3% block rate, avg 27 turns).

benchmarks.name: ExploitBench Mean Capability Flags (AutoNudge arm)
benchmarks.description: Mean capability flags captured per trial in AutoNudge arm (harness re-prompts if model stops early). 16 flags across 5 tiers. 41 V8 environments.

benchmarks.name: CyberGym Any Crash Rate (1507 tasks)
benchmarks.description: % of CyberGym tasks where model produced any crash in target (regardless of reaching targeted vuln). 1507 tasks, pass@1.

benchmarks.name: OSS-Fuzz ≥0.4 (Write Primitive or better)
benchmarks.description: % of OSS-Fuzz targets where model achieved at least 0.4 grade (write primitive or better, beyond just memory-safety crash).

benchmarks.name: UK AISI 'Doing Life' Cyber Range Max Step Reached (out of 23)
benchmarks.description: UK AI Security Institute 'Doing Life' cyber range (hardened small enterprise: AV, signed traffic, no legacy protocols). Max step reached out of 23. No model has fully solved; current max is step 21.

benchmarks.name: UK AISI 'The Last Ones' Cyber Range Success Rate (out of 10)
benchmarks.description: UK AISI 'The Last Ones' enterprise network attack simulation. End-to-end completion success rate over 10 attempts. Baseline small enterprise security.

benchmarks.name: Fable 5 Cyber Classifier Block Rate (ExploitBench)
benchmarks.description: Anthropic Fable 5 cyber-safeguard classifier — % of ExploitBench episodes flagged (causing fallback to Opus 4.8). Higher is better for safety. Avg turns until flag: 27.
